thread:
maya.pm: Quick sync — I pushed a PRD draft for the streaming SDK surface and retry/backoff semantics. customer asks: low-latency streaming for live chat + deterministic reconnects when mobile flaps. Need to agree scope and launch criteria.

sam.eng: link?

maya.pm: https://redwood-internal/s/streams-sdk-prd (summary below). Top questions: resume semantics vs at-least-once, explicit resume_token, and ergonomic JS iterator API.

li.platform: Two platform constraints: must work with hosted + dedicated + private. Private installs may not support websockets outbound; fallback to chunked HTTP streaming required.

sam.eng: Proposal: single async-iterator JS surface that abstracts transport. Example: ```js
const stream = client.chat.stream({model:'rwd-1', resume: true, retry:{policy:'idempotent', maxAttempts:3, backoff:'expo', jitter:true}})
for await (const ev of stream) { /* partial tokens, events */ }
```
Support resume_token emitted periodically so reconnect resumes from last ACK.

ana.qe: acceptance criteria please — I need testcases.

maya.pm: Rough ACs: 1) SDK exposes async iterator + on('meta') hooks; 2) server emits resume_token every X tokens; 3) reconnect uses resume_token to dedupe tokens (no duplicates visible to app); 4) retry/backoff honors server Retry-After and client expo with jitter; 5) metrics: streaming error-rate <1% for canary customers, median tail token-latency <50ms.

li.platform: Edge cases to call out: partial last-token (split UTF-8), resume_token expiration, session affinity changes across regions, and KV-cache mismatch for model stateful streaming (e.g., per-session semantics). Also: ensure private deployments can opt-out of resume (privacy/consistency).

sam.eng: Implementation note: server will provide per-chunk seq_id + resume_token. Client must track last-acked seq_id. On reconnect, send prefer-resume: <token>. If token rejected, fallback to full re-request with onResumeError callback.

ana.qe: Test matrix: network jitter (100-1000ms), packet loss 0-10%, reconnect after 0.2s-30s, private deployment with HTTP-chunked only. Add fuzz tests for multi-byte character boundaries.

maya.pm: Launch criteria (suggested): docs + samples, SDK unit + integration tests, canary with 10 beta customers for 2 weeks, telemetry dashboard (token-latency, reconnect-rate, resume-success-rate), and playbook for rollbacks.

sam.eng: Scope negotiation: MVP = async iterator + resume_token + simple retry policy (expo + jitter) + docs. Phase 2 = advanced idempotency keys, auto-merge partial responses, and server-side dedupe.

li.platform: Also require a feature-flaggable server-side rollout path and a compatibility header so older SDKs ignore new resume behavior.

maya.pm: Action items: sam - produce API surface PR by Mon, li - server headers/seq_id design by Wed, ana - test plan draft by Thu. I'll own docs + canary plan.

deploy-bot: deploy status: stream-server branch "stream-resume" built, staging deployed at 2026-03-18T21:32:00Z.

sam.eng: acked. I'll start a small prototype and share sample code.

maya.pm: Great — we should sync Friday to lock acceptance criteria and launch targets. :calendar:
